_comment: Edit this file for each release. editions: newest last. watch: AI proposals from the frozen snapshot and their status (each needs a stable id; it is also the key for stored votes).

editions.label: Paper release

editions.label: Q1 update

watch.proposal: Train only the router to increase expert reuse over consecutive tokens while preserving language-model performance.
watch.problem: Fetching uncached mixture-of-experts experts causes substantial I/O overhead.

watch.proposal: Adapt a frozen world model through low-rank updates and compose adapters for combinations of dynamics changes.
watch.problem: Pretrained world models must adapt to changing environments while retaining prior capabilities.

watch.proposal: Predict expert demand from prompt topics, then prefetch experts and coordinate caching without changing the model.
